reviews.text:
I had an amazing experience at
Level Posh Salon!
Nadia is an incredible stylist. She really listened to what I wanted and made my hair look absolutely stunning. The salon atmosphere is elegant, relaxing and welcoming. I highly recommend Nadia as your trusted advisor for all your hair care needs!

I always go to Sharon for my hair. She does an amazing job with coloring services and the blend! I highly recommend Sharon to anyone looking for top notch service and results with fair prices! She is skilled and knowledgeable and takes the time to understand what you want.

The best experience! Best place for color that lasts and true artistry in styling. Tanya is creative and listens - so easy to work with. I love the Eufora products she uses in this salon. Wish I could give more stars!
